chapters.title: Plain recursion

frames.caption: Plain recursion — O(2m+n) time, O(m + n) extra space. Input: longest_common_subsequence(a='abcde', b='ace'). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
def f(i, j): (LCS of a[:i] and b[:j])
return max(f(i - 1, j), f(i, j - 1)) — calls f(i=3, j=2)
return max(f(i - 1, j), f(i, j - 1)) — calls f(i=1, j=1)
return max(f(i - 1, j), f(i, j - 1)) — calls f(i=3, j=1)
return max(f(i - 1, j), f(i, j - 1)) — calls f(i=2, j=1)
return max(f(i - 1, j), f(i, j - 1)) — calls f(i=1, j=1)
